name: nightcast
description: Verifiable randomness for Midnight smart contracts, games, lotteries and AI agents.

scripts.compact: npm run compact -w @nightcast/contract && npm run compact:fast -w @nightcast/lotto
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nightcast/contract && npm run build -w @nightcast/sdk && npm run build -w @nightcast/deploy && npm run build -w @nightcast/lotto
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @nightcast/contract && npm run typecheck -w @nightcast/sdk && npm run typecheck -w @nightcast/deploy && npm run typecheck -w @nightcast/lotto
scripts.test: npm test -w @nightcast/contract && npm test -w @nightcast/sdk && npm test -w @nightcast/deploy && npm test -w @nightcast/lotto
